Gold.note: Strong central bank demand and anticipated rate cuts support further upside.

Silver.note: Robust photovoltaic demand and structural deficits drive outperformance versus gold.

Copper.note: Electrification trends and constrained mine supply underpin a bullish structural outlook.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficits and renewed global nuclear capacity additions support higher prices.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and EV demand growth deceleration weigh on near-term pricing.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and weak stainless steel demand cap upside potential.

Zinc.note: Treatment charge collapses indicate tight concentrate supply and smelter curtailments.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in China's property sector and steel demand limits price recovery.

Coal.note: Peaking global thermal demand and ample seaborne supply offset tight metallurgical markets.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic export controls and supply chain diversification provide a floor despite weak auto demand.

Manganese.note: Sluggish steel production in China limits demand for this critical steelmaking alloy.

PGM.note: Supply constraints in South Africa and hydrogen economy potential offset weak auto catalyst demand.

Potash.note: Tight global inventories and steady agricultural application rates support firm pricing.

Aluminum.note: Smelter capacity caps in China and strong green energy demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore provides resilience amid mixed macro signals.
